title: internal/runconfig/doc.go still calls the runners.toml format 'ticks' to publish' beside a doc ticfac now owns
description:
doc.go's migrator paragraph ends 'writing is authoring and the format is ticks' to publish', while the authoring doc and schema it describes now live in internal/runconfig (vendored by this tick) and the execution half of the format is ticfac's. The sentence about tk config migrate being the only writer is probably still right; the ownership clause is not, and the same paragraph should say which half (execution vs tracker tables) each claim covers. Comment-only, no behaviour.

ticfac run epic-6in filed this backlog tick from the finding 7aca48bce508ca0f091ef99b62786d7c1cfa47264c1d85af317d3779eb39d6d6 (reported by run-epic-6in/tick-4i8/attempt-3): the done is reachable with the finding standing, so it is a backlog tick with an owner rather than the epic's to absorb. The decision record is .ticfac/runs/epic-6in/absorptions/7aca48bce508ca0f091ef99b62786d7c1cfa47264c1d85af317d3779eb39d6d6.json on the run branch.
